crossRefs.note: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle…
When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God…
They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life…
The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring, who keep God’s…
John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was…
He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.
even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of…
For there are three who testify:
Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is…
Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter.
Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive…
for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”
For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.
But arise, and stand on your feet, for I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you a servant and a witness…
That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw…
We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.
translations.bsb: who testifies to everything he saw. This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
translations.kjv: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.
translations.asv: who bare witness of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, even of all things that he saw.
